limitations: Occupation profiles are not live job postings
O*NET alternate titles can map one project role to multiple occupation codes
The generated project-role crosswalk requires human review and is not a training label source until approved
One profile per occupation is not sufficient by itself to train a robust classifier

sources.name: Career Intelligence synthetic demo corpus
sources.attribution: Synthetic examples created for development; contain no personal data.
limitations: Not suitable for model training or evaluation claims

sources.name: Djinni Recruitment Dataset (English subsets)
sources.version: Pinned Hugging Face dataset revisions in config/djinni_datasets.json
sources.license: MIT (as declared by the dataset and its paper)
sources.attribution: Drushchak, Nazarii and Mariana Romanyshyn. 2024. Introducing the Djinni Recruitment Dataset: A Corpus of Anonymized CVs and Job Postings. UNLP @ LREC-COLING 2024. The dataset card thanks Djinni for providing the dataset.
limitations: Job descriptions have source role titles; project-role mappings are exact-alias-only and may be blank
Dataset paper describes PII removal but heuristic redaction is not a guarantee of de-identification
Keep candidate profiles local and git-ignored; review privacy obligations before reuse or deployment
Do not use this corpus as the held-out evaluation set
